blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the ₱384.92-million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the ₱43.76-million Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Sunday, Oct. 11, 2026. According to PCSO results provided for the draw, the Ultra Lotto 6/58 winning combination was 37-33-14-06-35-41, with a jackpot prize of ₱384.92 million. No ticket holder matched all six numbers. The Super Lotto 6/49 draw produced the winning combination 13-22-40-34-04-41, with a jackpot of ₱43.76 million. No bettor won the top prize.
